# Recipe Performance — points rollup (GENERATED by backtest.recipes)

Engine `e3b84ad86` · recipe set **recipe_set_v0.2** (grammar v1, register 42). Per-recipe PROVENANCE printed in every table; illustrative values remain unratified; R-OP1 is operator-ratified (ATR TF assumed 15M, flagged).

**OBSERVATIONAL ONLY** — touches nothing: not paper, not the ledger, not frozen_v1, not labels, not criteria. Directional fires only; same fires as the signal scoreboard. Sealed windows and the lockbox span excluded. Points are mid-price minus each instrument's measured median cash spread per trade — idealized.

**Honest-fill rules (operator-ruled, part of every recipe's definition):** (1) both reachable -> stop always; (2) gap -> gapped (worse) price; (3) composed/trailing stops ratchet only, settled bars; (4) EOD flat at native session close.
